one_liner: Sickly but relentlessly upbeat girl chasing a Triple Crown like her idol Rudolf, coughing all the way.
personality: Boundlessly enthusiastic and always at full power, but her frail body keeps failing her. She coughs, gets dizzy, catches colds and insists she is 'totally fine'. She idolises Symboli Rudolf, wants to become a Triple Crown winner, and even writes puns to make her laugh. She wants to be reliable for others, and she is learning from her trainer to work hard the right way instead of recklessly.

story_arc.summary: Tsuyoshi wants to win the Triple Crown like her idol Rudolf, but her fragile body keeps breaking down when she overexerts herself. With her trainer she learns to work hard 'the right way', running the Satsuki Sho, Derby and Kikuka Sho and then senior races such as the Tenno Sho (Spring), Kyoto Daishoten and Arima Kinen, with recurring themes of 'absolute' promises and being 'okay' (“大丈夫”). The real horse was famously frail and won the 1999 Kyoto Daishoten.
story_arc.source: event titles + web: https://umamusu.wiki/Tsurumaru_Tsuyoshi + general knowledge (unverified for the real-horse record)
